WHAT_THIS_REGISTRY_IS.rule: It records THAT three independent certifications OCCURRED, on which artifacts, at which blobs, and with what verdict string. It is occurrence materialization. It is NOT a reconstruction of the certifications themselves.
WHAT_THIS_REGISTRY_IS.authorizing_decision: OD-6, ratified (RATIFIED_MATERIALIZE_GOING_FORWARD): 'Independent-certification VERDICTS must be materialized as tracked repository evidence for future certifications.'
WHAT_THIS_REGISTRY_IS.why_these_three_fall_on_the_GOING_FORWAR: OD-6 was ratified in commit bee14e0a17fca6c6557b8e5e931fc32af789b49b, dated 2026-09-21. All three certifications recorded below occurred on 2026-09-22, strictly after it, and bee14e0a is an ancestor of this lane's merge head. They are therefore future certifications in OD-6's sense, for which materialization is REQUIRED rather than forbidden. This is the opposite posture to the v1.0.2 recertification recorded at the DAG amendment v1.0.1's N02_RESOLUTION, which predated OD-6 and is permanently non-materializable.
WHAT_THIS_REGISTRY_IS.scope_limit: VERDICT ARTIFACTS ONLY, per OD-6's own scope clause. No conversation transcript, session log or reviewer narrative is stored here, and no secret material may ever be.

WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.rule: Three classes of content that a registry like this invites, and that this one refuses to invent.
WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.reviewer_identity: NOT SUPPLIED. No artifact in this repository names a reviewer for any of the three certifications. A reviewer name is recorded as an explicit hole, never as a plausible attribution.
WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.exact_timestamps: NOT SUPPLIED. The certification DATE is recorded where the lane mandate states it; no hour, minute or UTC instant is invented to make the record look more precise than the evidence is.
WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.historical_verdict_documents: NOT RECONSTRUCTED. No prior verdict file is written, backdated or reconstructed as prose. The verdict STRING is recorded because the lane mandate supplies it verbatim; the verdict DOCUMENT is not manufactured around it.
WHAT_IS_NOT_FABRICATED_HERE.why_this_matters: OD-6's own reasoning is that reconstructing a past verdict as a document would be writing history rather than recording it. A registry that filled its holes with reasonable-looking values would commit exactly that error while appearing to comply.

DERIVED_FACTS.why_the_last_number_is_zero: Every one of the three verdicts certifies an AUTHORITY PACKAGE. None of the three demonstrates a mechanism, supplies an owner datum, or fills an evidence artifact, which is what closing N05, N06 or N07 respectively would require. A registry that let three PASS strings read as three closed nodes would be the most expensive error it could make.
DERIVED_FACTS.derivation_note: OCCURRENCE_COUNT and CERTIFIED_ARTIFACT_COUNT are derived by counting this document's own OCCURRENCES array and the union of its certified_artifacts entries, and are re-derivable by any reader from the arrays above.
